userStories.title: Add bridge.ts wrapping window.openai with coalescing + debounce
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a typed bridge to window.openai that coalesces structural-edit messages and debounces context updates. No-ops cleanly when host is absent so the bundle works in plain browser tabs.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/mcp-app/src/bridge.ts exports sendMessage(event) and updateModelContext(patch)
sendMessage coalesces calls within a 200ms window into one window.openai.sendMessage invocation with a merged payload
updateModelContext debounces 250ms and throttles to at most one call per second
When window.openai is undefined, both functions return silently (no throw, no console error)
Export a WidgetState type: { kind: 'navigate' | 'create'; flowSlug?: string; nodeId?: string; projectSlug?: string; backendUrl: string; backendToken: string; justCreated?: boolean }
Unit tests in apps/mcp-app/src/bridge.test.ts cover: coalescing window, debounce timing, throttle cap, no-op when window.openai missing
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

acceptanceCriteria: Generate a random per-process token at studio boot (crypto.randomUUID() or 32 bytes hex), stored in memory on the Studio instance
Expose studio.token field accessible to the MCP server factory
Extend existing Hono CORS middleware: allow Origin: null only when X-Seeflow-Token request header equals studio.token
Requests from null origin without the matching token receive 403
Existing same-origin (localhost:5173) and other localhost origins continue to work unchanged for the dev SPA
Token is never persisted to disk, never logged
Unit test in apps/studio/src/ verifies: null origin + correct token = allowed; null origin + missing/wrong token = denied; localhost:5173 = allowed without token

Tests pass
